title: Search release announcement
prompt:
Write a product announcement of at most 120 words for version 2.4 of a notes app. The new behavior is faster search.

Use these exact markdown headings: ## What is new, ## How to update.
Mention 2.4 and search. Do not claim the app is bug-free.
constraints: Headings: What is new, How to update
Does not claim the app is bug-free
